ios.desc:
LUX Video is a powerful, high-performance media player built for iPhone, iPad, and Apple TV. Play your video collection in HD and 4K with native format support, local offline storage, and direct network server streaming. No file conversion needed!
PLAY ALL FORMATS
Natively play MKV, MP4, AVI, MOV, FLV, WMV, WebM, TS, M2TS, and more. If you have the file, LUX Video plays it smoothly.
LOCAL & NETWORK STREAMING (ALL DEVICES)
• Offline Storage: Play videos saved on your device or Apple TV with zero lag.
• Wi-Fi Web Transfer: Upload videos wirelessly from any Mac, PC, or phone web browser directly to your Apple TV, iPhone, or iPad.
• Network Server Streaming: Connect to SMB, FTP, SFTP, and WebDAV drives, plus full support for Plex Media Server (with one-click plex.tv/link PIN login), Emby, and Jellyfin.
• Playlists: Create and manage video playlists across your media collection.
• Subtitle Engine: customizable font size and colors.

OPTIMIZED FOR APPLE TV
• Siri Remote Navigation: Seamless grid browsing designed for Apple TV remote control.
• Top Shelf Integration: Jump right into your recent videos from the Apple TV home screen.

NOTE: LUX Video is a local media player for user-owned files. It does not provide copyrighted content or interface with third-party video sharing platforms.
